e.title: Property Hazard MCP · 美国单一地址多灾种风险查询（已与 FEMA 官方数据交叉核对）
e.title_en: Property Hazard MCP — multi-peril hazard lookup for a single US address (cross-checked against FEMA’s own data)
e.title_hk: Property Hazard MCP · 美國單一地址多災種風險查詢（已與 FEMA 官方數據交叉核對）
e.summary: 输入一个美国地址，返回洪水分区/野火/地震 PGA/离岸距离与综合风险分级；实测洪水分区与 FEMA 官方服务一致
e.summary_en: Given one US address, returns flood zone, wildfire, seismic PGA, coastal distance and a composite tier; its flood zone matched FEMA’s own service in testing
e.summary_hk: 輸入一個美國地址，返回洪水分區/野火/地震 PGA/離岸距離與綜合風險分級；實測洪水分區與 FEMA 官方服務一致
e.body:
**Property Hazard MCP**（官方 registry 条目 `ai.zipquote/us-property-hazard-risk`，**v1.0.0，2026-07-26 更新，status active**，端点 `https://mcp.zipquote.ai/mcp`）做的事非常具体：**输入一个美国地址，返回该地址的自然灾害暴露**。仓库 `github.com/ericshenus/us-property-hazard-risk`（**MIT**、★0、**2026-07-26 创建 / 07-28 最后推送**、**59 KB**、**Python**）。

**本次做了完整握手与真实调用（不是读描述）**：`initialize` 返回 `serverInfo {"name":"Property Hazard MCP","version":"1.28.1"}`（协议 2025-06-18，具备 tools / prompts / resources），服务端 `instructions` 自述为「查询单一地址的洪水、野火、地震与海岸风暴暴露」；`tools/list` 返回 **1 个工具**：**`assess_property_hazard`**，入参只有 `address`（必填），描述说明它会**校验并对地址做地理编码（US C[ensus]…）**。**实际调用 `1200 Brickell Ave, Miami, FL 33131` 的返回如下（可复核）**：

- `validated: true`、标准化地址 `1200 BRICKELL AVE, MIAMI, FL, 33131`，坐标 **25.76221823112 / -80.191806017684**
- **`flood_zone: "AE"`、`sfha: true`**（AE 属 FEMA 的**特殊洪水危险区**）、`flood_available: true`
- **`wildfire_score: 2`**、**`seismic_pga: 0.022`**、**`fault_distance_miles: 864.6`**、**`coastal_distance_miles: 0.5`**
- **`hazard_score: 53`、`hazard_tier: "Very High"`**，并给出**驱动因素清单**：`["Flood Zone AE", "Wildfire Medium", "Immediate coastal exposure"]`

⭐⭐ **本轮最关键的一步是外部交叉核对**：把返回坐标拿去查 **FEMA 自己的 NFHL 服务**（`hazards.fema.gov/arcgis/rest/services/public/NFHL/MapServer/28/query`），返回 **`FLD_ZONE: "AE"`、`SFHA_TF: "T"`**——**与该工具给出的 AE / sfha=true 完全一致**。地理常识层面也自洽：Brickell 位于迈阿密海滨（离岸 0.5 英里、属特殊洪水危险区均合理）、佛州远离断层（864.6 英里）且地震 PGA 极低（0.022）。**即：这不是一个「描述漂亮」的服务，而是一个能被官方数据验证真实输出的服务。**

对 RIAA：**这是本会话发现的、最接近「承保第一步」的可用工具之一**——**报价前对单一地址做多灾种筛查，正是财产险承保与定价的实际动作**。池内在「灾害风险」上已有很厚的一层：美国洪水口径有 [[fema-nfhl-mcp]]、[[rfema]]、[[duckdb-fema-nfip]]，地震有 [[usgs-earthquake-api]]，巨灾建模有 [[openquake-engine]]、[[climada]]、[[climate-conditioned-cat]]、[[hazimp]]、[[typhoon-cat-model]]、[[gem-global-exposure-model]]、[[opendrr-riskprofiler]]、[[perils-ied]]，空间集中度有 [[spatialrisk]]，但**「**输入一个地址 → 一次拿到多种灾种 + 综合分级 + 驱动因素**」这一层此前没有**；它与本轮同批收录的 [[floodwise]]（**英国**邮编级洪水）正好构成**「英/美两地、地址级灾害筛查」**的一对。业务上可直接用于：**承保筛选与风险分级、巨灾暴露清点、参数险触发条件设计（[[aegis-parametric]]、[[parametric-insurance-demo]]）、再保与巨灾债券的风险分层（[[cat-bond-pricing]]）**；上游若要与官方工具链打通，可对照 [[fema-nfhl-mcp]] 与 [[usgs-earthquake-api]]。

⚠️ **如实标注**：**① 综合分的算法未公开**——`hazard_score`/`hazard_tier`（53 / Very High）与 `wildfire_score` 的量纲在本次探测中**无法确定**，属**启发式合成指标而非可审计模型**，不能作为定价依据；**② 只测了一个地址**——虽经 FEMA 官方数据交叉核对，但**样本为 1**，`wildfire_score` 等分支**未独立验证**；**③ 商业背景**——由报价平台 zipquote.ai 发布（MCP 是免鉴权调用，但服务本身可能是其报价产品的入口），**长期可用性与免费额度无承诺**；**④** 仓库 ★0、最后推送 **2026-07-28**，而托管服务版本已 **1.28.1**，**说明仓库可能滞后于线上服务**，源码不可视为线上实现；**⑤** 洪水之外的字段（野火/地震/海岸）**未与 USGS、WFIGS 等官方源逐一比对**。**核实说明**：官方 registry 条目、端点 `initialize` / `tools/list`、**一次真实工具调用及其完整返回**、仓库元数据、**以及 FEMA NFHL 官方服务的独立交叉核对（FLD_ZONE=AE、SFHA_TF=T，吻合）** 均经实测；**未注册账号、未做多地址或多灾种抽样验证**。
e.body_en:
**Property Hazard MCP** (official registry entry `ai.zipquote/us-property-hazard-risk`, **v1.0.0, updated 2026-07-26, status active**, endpoint `https://mcp.zipquote.ai/mcp`) does something very specific: **give it one US address and it returns that address’s natural-hazard exposure**. Repository `github.com/ericshenus/us-property-hazard-risk` (**MIT**, 0 stars, **created 2026-07-26 / last pushed 07-28**, **59 KB**, **Python**).

**A full handshake and a real call were performed here (not just reading the description)**: `initialize` returned `serverInfo {"name":"Property Hazard MCP","version":"1.28.1"}` (protocol 2025-06-18; tools, prompts and resources advertised), with server `instructions` describing "flood, wildfire, earthquake, and coastal-storm hazard exposure for a single address"; `tools/list` returned **one tool**: **`assess_property_hazard`**, whose only input is a required `address`, and whose description says it **validates and geocodes the address (US C[ensus]…)**. **The actual call for `1200 Brickell Ave, Miami, FL 33131` returned (re-checkable)**:

- `validated: true`, standardized address `1200 BRICKELL AVE, MIAMI, FL, 33131`, coordinates **25.76221823112 / -80.191806017684**
- **`flood_zone: "AE"`, `sfha: true`** (zone AE is a FEMA **Special Flood Hazard Area**), `flood_available: true`
- **`wildfire_score: 2`**, **`seismic_pga: 0.022`**, **`fault_distance_miles: 864.6`**, **`coastal_distance_miles: 0.5`**
- **`hazard_score: 53`** with **`hazard_tier: "Very High"`**, plus a **driver list**: `["Flood Zone AE", "Wildfire Medium", "Immediate coastal exposure"]`

⭐⭐ **The decisive step this round was external cross-checking**: feeding those coordinates into **FEMA’s own NFHL service** (`hazards.fema.gov/arcgis/rest/services/public/NFHL/MapServer/28/query`) returned **`FLD_ZONE: "AE"`, `SFHA_TF: "T"`** — **exactly matching the tool’s `flood_zone: AE` / `sfha: true`**. The geography is self-consistent too: Brickell sits on the Miami waterfront (0.5 miles to the coast and a Special Flood Hazard Area both make sense), and Florida is far from any fault (864.6 miles) with very low seismic PGA (0.022). **In other words, this is not a service that merely describes itself well — it is one whose real output can be verified against official data.**

For RIAA: **this is among the most directly usable "first step in underwriting" tools found in this session** — **screening a single address for multiple perils before quoting is exactly what property underwriting and pricing actually do**. The corpus already has a thick natural-hazard layer: US flood via [[fema-nfhl-mcp]], [[rfema]] and [[duckdb-fema-nfip]]; earthquakes via [[usgs-earthquake-api]]; cat modelling via [[openquake-engine]], [[climada]], [[climate-conditioned-cat]], [[hazimp]], [[typhoon-cat-model]], [[gem-global-exposure-model]], [[opendrr-riskprofiler]] and [[perils-ied]]; and spatial concentration via [[spatialrisk]]. But **"one address in → several perils plus an overall tier plus the drivers" had no entry**; together with [[floodwise]] (UK postcode-level flood), also added this round, it forms a **UK/US pair of address-level hazard screening**. Direct business uses: **underwriting screening and risk tiering, catastrophe exposure inventory, parametric trigger design ([[aegis-parametric]], [[parametric-insurance-demo]]) and reinsurance/cat-bond risk layering ([[cat-bond-pricing]])**; to connect it to official tooling, compare [[fema-nfhl-mcp]] and [[usgs-earthquake-api]].

⚠️ **Stated plainly**: **① the composite algorithm is not public** — the scale behind `hazard_score`/`hazard_tier` (53 / Very High) and `wildfire_score` **could not be determined in this probe**, so they are **heuristic composites rather than an auditable model** and must not drive pricing; **② only one address was tested** — although it was cross-checked against FEMA’s own data, the **sample size is 1**, and branches such as `wildfire_score` **were not independently verified**; **③ commercial context** — published by the quoting platform zipquote.ai (the MCP call needed no authentication, but the service may be a funnel for its quoting product), with **no commitment on availability or a free tier**; **④** the repository has 0 stars and was last pushed **2026-07-28** while the hosted service is already at **1.28.1**, so **the repo may lag the live service** and its source should not be read as the deployed implementation; **⑤** fields other than flood (wildfire, seismic, coastal) **were not compared one by one against USGS, WFIGS or other official sources**. **Verification note**: the official registry entry, the endpoint’s `initialize`/`tools/list`, **one real tool call with its complete return**, the repository metadata, **and an independent cross-check against FEMA’s NFHL service (FLD_ZONE=AE, SFHA_TF=T — matching)** were all measured; **no account was registered and no multi-address or multi-peril sampling was done**.
e.body_hk:
**Property Hazard MCP**（官方 registry 條目 `ai.zipquote/us-property-hazard-risk`，**v1.0.0，2026-07-26 更新，status active**，端點 `https://mcp.zipquote.ai/mcp`）做的事非常具體：**輸入一個美國地址，返回該地址的自然災害暴露**。倉庫 `github.com/ericshenus/us-property-hazard-risk`（**MIT**、★0、**2026-07-26 建立 / 07-28 最後推送**、**59 KB**、**Python**）。

**本次做了完整握手與真實調用**：`initialize` 返回 `serverInfo {"name":"Property Hazard MCP","version":"1.28.1"}`；`tools/list` 返回 **1 個工具** **`assess_property_hazard`**（入參僅 `address`，必填）；**實際調用 `1200 Brickell Ave, Miami, FL 33131` 的返回**：標準化地址 `1200 BRICKELL AVE, MIAMI, FL, 33131`、座標 **25.76221823112 / -80.191806017684**、**`flood_zone: "AE"`、`sfha: true`**、**`wildfire_score: 2`**、**`seismic_pga: 0.022`**、**`fault_distance_miles: 864.6`**、**`coastal_distance_miles: 0.5`**、**`hazard_score: 53`、`hazard_tier: "Very High"`**，並給出驅動因素 `["Flood Zone AE", "Wildfire Medium", "Immediate coastal exposure"]`。

⭐⭐ **本輪最關鍵的一步是外部交叉核對**：把座標拿去查 **FEMA 自己的 NFHL 服務**，返回 **`FLD_ZONE: "AE"`、`SFHA_TF: "T"`**——**與該工具的 AE / sfha=true 完全一致**；地理常識亦自洽（Brickell 位於邁阿密海濱、佛州遠離斷層且地震 PGA 極低）。**即這不是「描述漂亮」的服務，而是輸出可被官方數據驗證真實的服務。**

對 RIAA：**這是本會話發現的、最接近「承保第一步」的可用工具之一**。池內災害風險層已很厚（[[fema-nfhl-mcp]]、[[rfema]]、[[duckdb-fema-nfip]]、[[usgs-earthquake-api]]、[[openquake-engine]]、[[climada]]、[[climate-conditioned-cat]]、[[hazimp]]、[[typhoon-cat-model]]、[[gem-global-exposure-model]]、[[opendrr-riskprofiler]]、[[perils-ied]]、[[spatialrisk]]），但**「輸入一個地址 → 一次拿到多種災種 + 綜合分級 + 驅動因素」此前沒有**；與同批收錄的 [[floodwise]]（**英國**郵編級洪水）構成**英/美「地址級災害篩查」一對**。可用於承保篩選與風險分級、巨災暴露清點、參數險觸發設計（[[aegis-parametric]]、[[parametric-insurance-demo]]）、巨災債券分層（[[cat-bond-pricing]]）。

⚠️ **如實標注**：**① 綜合分算法未公開**——`hazard_score`/`hazard_tier` 與 `wildfire_score` 的量綱**無法確定**，屬**啟發式合成指標而非可審計模型**，不能作為定價依據；**② 只測了一個地址**，`wildfire_score` 等分支**未獨立驗證**；**③ 商業背景**——由報價平台 zipquote.ai 發布，**長期可用性無承諾**；**④** 倉庫最後推送 **2026-07-28** 而託管服務已 **1.28.1**，**源碼可能滯後於線上服務**；**⑤** 洪水之外的欄位**未與 USGS、WFIGS 等官源逐一比對**。**核實說明**：registry 條目、`initialize`／`tools/list`、**一次真實工具調用及完整返回**、倉庫元數據、**以及 FEMA NFHL 官方服務的獨立交叉核對（吻合）** 均經實測；**未註冊帳號、未做多地址抽樣驗證**。
e.verified_note: 官方 MCP registry 实测（ai.zipquote/us-property-hazard-risk v1.0.0；updatedAt 2026-07-26；status active；remote https://mcp.zipquote.ai/mcp 无鉴权头）+ 端点握手（initialize 返回 serverInfo "Property Hazard MCP" 1.28.1 / protocolVersion 2025-06-18 / capabilities tools+prompts+resources；tools/list 返回 1 个工具 assess_property_hazard，inputSchema 仅要求 address）+ 真实调用（1200 Brickell Ave, Miami, FL 33131 → validated true、matched_address、lat 25.76221823112 / lng -80.191806017684、flood_zone AE、sfha true、wildfire_score 2、seismic_pga 0.022、fault_distance_miles 864.6、coastal_distance_miles 0.5、hazard_score 53、hazard_tier Very High、hazard_drivers 三项）★独立交叉核对：FEMA NFHL MapServer/28 查询同坐标返回 FLD_ZONE=AE、SFHA_TF=T，与该工具一致 + 仓库元数据（MIT；★0；created 2026-07-26；pushed 2026-07-28；59KB；Python）；未注册账号、未做多地址抽样
